versions.content: MetaData support is required if J1939TpConnection. useVariableSA is used The usage of J1939TpConnection.useVari- ableSA requires the support of COM Stack MetaData with MetaDataType = SOURCE_ADDRESS_16. Please note that this affects J1939TpConnection.tpPg. sdus that in turn are referenced by a PduTriggering that references an IPduPort with communicationDirection = out (in other words Tx Pdus).
